questions.prompt: What was in the guide? JR
questions.passage:
"I want to see a lion, a green parrot and a monkey."

"I think we can manage that," replied Gran.

She and Grandpa had taken three year old Ashley and her little brother Blake to the zoo. Gran looked at the guide. This was a map of the zoo with pictures, showing where the animals were. The lions were at the back of the zoo, so would be the last animals that they got to.

Some of the monkeys were swinging on ropes. Others were playing chasing games through the trees. The older, grey monkeys sat or lay dozing in the sun.

"Where is the green parrot?" asked Ashley. "I can't see it!"

Grandpa pointed to the grass at the bottom of the cage. "That's because it's the same colour as the grass," he said.

"Oh, now I see the parrot!" she laughed.

They stopped to eat sandwiches by the pond.

They reached the lions just on feeding time. Up on the warm rocks, they were relaxing in the sun. They rose to their feet when their food arrived, then raced down and leapt to the ground. Their roars echoed around the zoo.

Leaving to go home, Ashley could still hear them.

"What was the best part?" asked Gran.

"The sparrows eating Blake's sandwiches."
